project.description: Umbrella project grouping the Q3 security-hardening findings. Each child case is one finding; each todo on this project links to its child case.

items.title: Rotate exposed SFTP credential in payroll export job
items.description: The nightly payroll export reads an SFTP credential from a request-supplied client id. Scope it to the session identity and rotate the leaked key.

items.title: Parameterize the report filter query in LaborExplorer
items.description: Report filter builds raw SQL by string concatenation. Move to parameterized query with ? placeholders.
